name: gene-synthesis-hub
description: Electron desktop shell for the Gene Synthesis Hub. Modern UI around the existing Tkinter + Streamlit subapps; bundles a portable Python runtime and the subapp source so the whole thing ships in one folder with no install step.

scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.verify: npm run build && node scripts/verify-sg-check-edit.mjs && node scripts/verify-order-form-parity.mjs && node scripts/verify-sheet-range.mjs && node scripts/verify-colony-template.mjs && node scripts/verify-rounding.mjs && node scripts/verify-fullcalc.mjs && node scripts/verify-ligation-template.mjs && node scripts/verify-order-form-template.mjs && node scripts/verify-app-registry.mjs
scripts.verify:quick: node scripts/verify-sg-check-edit.mjs && node scripts/verify-order-form-parity.mjs && node scripts/verify-sheet-range.mjs && node scripts/verify-colony-template.mjs && node scripts/verify-rounding.mjs && node scripts/verify-fullcalc.mjs && node scripts/verify-ligation-template.mjs && node scripts/verify-order-form-template.mjs && node scripts/verify-app-registry.mjs
scripts.package:folder: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win dir --x64 --publish never
